autonomousDecisions.decision: PhlimboV3 is NOT appended to _phusdMinterCandidates(); the two-sided delta is expressed differently.
autonomousDecisions.rationale: The candidate set is `internal pure` over compile-time constants and PhlimboV3's address is a runtime CREATE, still address(0) at Phase 0. So only PHLIMBO_V2 was appended (index 19, require(i == 20)); the revoke side is a mask delta liveMask == baselineMask & ~(1 << 19), the grant side a direct runtime canMint assertion in both script and verifier, guarded by PHUSD_MINTER_BIT_PHLIMBO_V2 = 19 and _requirePhlimboV2BitIndex() so a reorder cannot silently repoint the delta.
autonomousDecisions.embeddedLiveFinding: The Phase 0 baseline mask reads 270080 on mainnet and BIT 19 IS CLEAR - PhlimboV2 does NOT currently hold phUSD mint authority, so step 14's revoke is a NO-OP today. Kept anyway (idempotent); the verifier logs a NOTE rather than implying it verified a revoke that never happened.

autonomousDecisions.decision: setDesiredAPY needed a second, non-vacuous assertion.
autonomousDecisions.rationale: PhlimboV2's live desiredAPYBps is already 0, so BOTH real uses target 0 and the prescribed desiredAPYBps()==0 read-back is vacuous. _setDesiredAPYTwoStep therefore also asserts !apySetInProgress(), which only the commit branch clears - otherwise a missed 100-block window on a --slow Ledger session passes silently.

autonomousDecisions.decision: Phase 8's mint-leg probe arms a temporary preview-only APY.
autonomousDecisions.rationale: With a mirrored APY of 0 a fresh V3 emits nothing, so the probe arms 1000 bps under vm.prank(OWNER), stakes, warps 30 days, claims, and asserts BOTH that wallet balance rose AND that unclaimablePhUSDOf stayed 0 - balance-only would pass on a claim that banked everything.

autonomousDecisions.decision: The PhlimboV3 mint-authority allowance assertion was corrected mid-run.
autonomousDecisions.rationale: The first version asserted a phUSD allowance from the new accumulator; the dry run FAILED - StableYieldAccumulator.approvePhlimbo approves rewardToken (:473), which on mainnet is USDC. Now asserts the allowance on SYA.rewardToken() read off the accumulator, plus a new SYA.rewardToken() == PhlimboV3.rewardToken() agreement check.

autonomousDecisions.decision: Staleness gate uses --fail-on-stale on :dry too, not --auto-refresh.
autonomousDecisions.rationale: check-phlimbo-snapshot-age.js gained --variant v1|v2 (default v1, existing callers unchanged) and --variant v2 --fail-on-stale is wired onto :dry, :broadcast and :resume alike - a silent auto-regeneration would move the seed list out from under an operator comparing a dry run to the broadcast they are about to sign.
